title: score_response result
description: Idempotent on (questionId, dimension): calling twice overwrites rather than appending. supersededPrevious tells the model it has already scored this pair, which is the signal that stops it re-scoring in a loop.

supersededPrevious.description: True when a working score already existed for this (questionId, dimension) and was replaced.

dimensionsScored.description: Distinct competencies with at least one working score across the session so far. Coverage hint.
